title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E02 — Pre-Production Begins
Pre-production forges on as the filmmakers are forced to make huge decisions regarding everything from props and gear, exposing who has the experience when it comes to production, and who could fall behind.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E02 — In a Dark Time
Seth and Kate pull off a heist; Ranger Gonzalez confronts nightmarish visions; Carlos's emergence from the Labyrinth.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E03 — Attack of the 50 ft. Sex Machine
Richie and Santanico pose as sex traffickers to infiltrate Malvado's food supply, while Sonja forces Seth to kick his drug habit. Meanwhile, Freddie faces off with Sex Machine.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E04 — The Best Little Horror House In Texas
Kate hunts down Scott in Bethel; Richie and Santanico find themselves deep in the flesh trade; Seth tries to get back on Uncle Eddie's good side.

title: Timecop
description: In 1994 a 2004 Washington policeman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) saves his wife (Mia Sara) and stops a sinister senator from buying the presidency.

title: Speed Kills
description: A wealthy speedboat racer leads a double life that gets him into trouble with the law and drug lords.

title: Dangerous
description: An ex-con and reformed sociopath battles a band of heavily armed mercenaries as he tries to uncover the truth behind his brother's mysterious death.

title: From Paris With Love
description: A low-ranking agent (Jonathan Rhys Meyers) joins forces with a trigger-happy operative (John Travolta) to stop a terrorist attack in France.

title: Accident Man
description: Mike Fallon is a seasoned hit man who is known for making his target's death look like an accident. When Fallon's girlfriend turns up dead, he goes after his old colleagues to find the one responsible.

title: Accident Man: Hitman's Holiday
description: A hit man must beat the top assassins in the world to protect the ungrateful son of a mafia boss, save the life of his only friend, and rekindle his relationship with his maniacal father figure.

title: The Foreigner
description: A businessman embarks on a revenge-fueled vendetta after his daughter dies in a terrorist bombing. His search leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

title: The Last Stand
description: A sheriff must take matters into his own hands when a notorious drug lord escapes from FBI custody and comes speeding toward a showdown in the lawman's quiet border town.

Officer Mike Chandler and a young civilian passenger find themselves unprepared and outgunned when fate puts them squarely in-the-crosshairs of a daring bank heist that is being carried out by a fearless team of highly trained and heavily armed men.

title: Meltdown
description: A faded action-star's (Jacky Cheung) bodyguard (Jet Li) saves his reputation and his life during a jewel heist.

title: The Dead One
description: A young man is killed and resurrected by the Aztec god of death.

title: Black Christmas
description: Sorority sisters (Olivia Hussey, Margot Kidder) and their drunken housemother fall prey to an obscene yuletide caller.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E05 — Bondage
The Gecko brothers finally call a truce and work together to find Malvado's headquarters; Carlos, unhinged from the Labyrinth, abducts Santanico and claims her for himself.

title: Tell
description: A small-time thief (Milo Ventimiglia) makes a big score and tries to keep it from his ex-partner, his ex-wife and other greedy sorts.

title: Andron
description: In 2154, young men and women must navigate their way through a deadly maze as spectators wager on their fates.

description: A security guard (Liam Hemsworth) and his childhood pal (Michael Angarano) make plans to rob an armored car.

description: Elite DEA agents are tasked with guarding a dangerous drug lord until he can be extracted. They soon find themselves at the center of an explosive ambush.

title: Redemption
description: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

title: Machete Kills
description: The president recruits ex-Federale Machete to take down an eccentric arms dealer who plans to spread war and anarchy throughout the world.

title: Megalodon Rising
description: An armada of modern warships proves no match for a megalodon: a giant shark thought to be extinct.

title: Megalodon: The Frenzy
description: The stakes have never been higher when a frenzy of five Megalodons, spawn of the original, terrorizes the open ocean.

title: Number One With a Bullet
description: A suave Los Angeles detective (Billy Dee Williams) and his quirky partner (Robert Carradine) hunt a drug lord who has social clout.

title: In the Name of the King: A Dungeon Siege Tale
description: As war looms in an idyllic kingdom, a man (Jason Statham) sets out to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claire Forlani) and avenge their murdered son.

title: Day of the Dead
description: The living dead regroup above while humans (Lori Cardille, Terry Alexander, Joseph Pilato) sweat it out below in a Florida missile silo.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E06 — Bizarre Tales
Freddie and Kate follow the trail of a mass grave to Oculto, a reclusive and dangerous Lord.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S02 E07 — Bring Me the Head of Santanico Pandemonium
Richie and Seth hatch a plan to complete Santanico's revenge; Freddie and Kate face an unexpected foe.

title: The Fast and the Fierce
description: When terrorists plant a bomb on a commercial flight, the passengers must fight to keep the plane in the air and everyone alive. If they let the plane dip below 800 feet, the bomb will go off and kill everyone.

title: Fast and Fierce: Death Race
description: Jack is on his way to grabbing the cash prize for an illegal car race in Mexico to California, when a desperate woman, fleeing from her gangster boyfriend who runs the tournament, jumps into his car pleading for help.

description: An American kickboxer trains with an Asian master to avenge his crippled brother in Thailand.
